result.topic_en: Numerical evaluation of the expression $x^7-28x^4+280x+200\cos\varphi$ at $x=\sqrt[3]{16}$, with a few decimal values worked out.

methods.what: Substitution of $x=\sqrt[3]{16}$ into $x^7-28x^4+280(x)+200\cos\varphi$, giving a constant plus a multiple of $\sqrt[3]{16}$ plus $200\cos\varphi$
Numerical evaluation of the resulting expression by subtracting decimal values
